script.description: A profile history kept across a session change.

steps.content:
import json, os, pathlib, pwd, time
p = pathlib.Path(pwd.getpwuid(os.getuid()).pw_dir) / ".local/state/profile/runs.jsonl"
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
start = time.time_ns() // 1000000
label = "second" if pathlib.Path("NOTES.md").exists() else "first"
row = {"start_ms": start, "end_ms": time.time_ns() // 1000000, "state": "ab" * 32, "result": label}
fd = os.open(p, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_APPEND, 0o600)
os.write(fd, (json.dumps(row) + "\n").encode())
os.close(fd)
print("PROFILE " + label)
